intentAndPurpose.intent: Bottom-anchored overlay sheet with semantic snap points (collapsed, halfExpanded, fullyExpanded, custom), drag handle, header/footer chrome, and scroll/drag arbitration. Supports fullView immersive layout, dismissible backdrop/back/swipe, and multi-accent appearance on an elevated surface.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: (open, details) => void — fires on open/close; details.reason reports why.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: (open) => void — fires after open/close animation.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Allow backdrop, back, or swipe dismiss.

props.name: snapPoint
props.description: Controlled semantic snap point.

props.name: defaultSnapPoint
props.description: Uncontrolled initial snap point.

props.name: availableSnapPoints
props.description: Semantic snap points gestures may select.

props.name: customSnapPoint
props.description: Positive number, px, or rem used when snapPoint is custom.

props.name: onSnapPointChange
props.description: (snapPoint, details) => void — fires when snap changes.

props.name: snapToSequentialPoints
props.description: Snap only to neighbouring points (no velocity skip).

props.name: handle
props.description: Show the drag handle.

props.name: header
props.description: Show header chrome.

props.name: title
props.description: Title content — boolean, string, or ReactNode.

props.name: description
props.description: Description content — boolean, string, or ReactNode.

props.name: start
props.description: Leading header action (Figma enum or ReactNode slot).

props.name: end
props.description: Trailing header action (Figma enum or ReactNode slot).

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Show a close control in the header.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the close control.

props.name: fullView
props.description: Immersive layout — body scroll from sheet top; handle/header overlay body.

props.name: topDivider
props.description: Divider below header (default layout).

props.name: bottomDivider
props.description: Divider above footer.

props.name: footer
props.description: Show footer chrome.

props.name: footerOrientation
props.description: Footer button stack direction.

props.name: footerStart
props.description: Leading footer action — boolean or ReactNode slot.

props.name: footerEnd
props.description: Trailing footer actions (typically Button(s)).

props.name: style
props.description: Inline native styles on the sheet container.

props.name: testID
props.description: React Native test identifier.
